senses.gloss: --a daughter of ऋषा; mother of Tortoise, शन्ख, etc. Br. III. 7. ४१४-17; वा. ६९. २९१-92.
(I)--means of living by ऋत, अमृत, मृत प्रमृत and सत्यामृत or सत्यानृत; never by श्ववृत्ति। भा. VII. ११. १८-20.
(II)--transformation of जयादेवस् in the seven epochs of Manu. Br. III. 4. १२, ३७.

(I)--a son of त्वष्ट्रि, created out of a sacrificial offering with an ugly appearance to avenge Indra, the mur- derer of विश्वरूप. Hari advised Indra on the means to end वृत्र. In the battle वृत्र encouraged his soldiers and uttered words of heroism. Ran towards Indra as कैटभ against Hari and had one hand cut off. But in the contest the Vajra of Indra slipped and वृक asked him to take up the weapon and fight. He had his other arm cut off. But वृक swallowed Indra into his stomach from which Indra escaped and cut off his head. वृत्र attained Aloka due to his faith in Hari having been born as Citraketu (s.v.) in his previous birth.
1: भा. VI. chh. 9-१२ (whole); ch. १४ (whole); १७. ३८-39; X. ७७. ३६; Br. III. ७२. ८३.
Attained release by सत्सन्ग। His greed for more territory.
2: भा. XI. १२. 5; XII. 3. ११.
Killed by हालाफल अवतार्। An account of the death in the भागवत; an Asura of कृतयुग.
3: M. ४७. ५१; ५३. २०; २४९. ६७.
Brought forth sons from his terrible breathing during his fight with Indra in thousands. All followers of Mahendra, those who have realised ब्रह्मा, are happy, dharmic and live in small bodies.
4: वा. ६८. ३४-6.
(II)--a son of अनायुष. Father of Bakas in hun- dreds who followed Mahendra. Br. III. 6. ३१.
--the ninth of the twelve incarnations of विष्णु. M. ४७. ४४.
--a R. from the पारियात्र hill; from ऋष्यवान्; in भारतवर्ष. Br. II. १६. २७; M. ११४. २३; वा. ४५. ९७ [page३-305+ ३१]
